item.name: Wine_Cooler
item.description: Insulated cooler used to chill wine cans; its ice is not served to guests.
item.readyBeforeUse: The cooler is clean, upright, and does not leak.
item.readyForNextPerson: The cooler is upright and closed. Meltwater is contained and no water has reached the playa.
item.ifNotReady: Do not use a leaking cooler. Tell the Bar Lead.
